entries.cause: First reading, from the first census of the ledger BY FORMULA rather than by key. src/proposition-address.ts folds statements that differ only in spelling (71076 keys to 70993 propositions) and cannot see two statements that are one formula written in a different order. Measured over an algebraic normal form quotienting commutativity, associativity where it holds, and the mirror symmetry of the order relations, and nothing else: 1530 of 71076 sealed statements are pure formulas, they hold 1325 distinct forms, and 205 are restatements. 190 of those sit inside ONE skill and are counted here; the other 15 are forms that two different skills arrive at with different glosses, which are crosses and are deliberately excluded. The largest single copy is the mod-9 multiplication table, sealed five times by z9-ring across Core.lean, Ring.lean and Vortex.lean under three names carrying the same gloss.

honest: The prior reading of every ratcheted measure, with the cause and the evidence for it. A reading is a MEASUREMENT of this repository, not a theorem: it is contingent, it is superseded by the next reading, and nothing can be derived from it — so it is sealed by content-address here rather than minted into the proof ledger. A raise with no cause or no evidence is refused outright, which is strictly more friction than the numeral it replaces: `<prefix>_<value>` went green with no reason recorded anywhere.
